_说明: 见证者点击气泡台词文件：格式=对象 {_说明, lines}，lines=字符串数组（句子池，句数不限）。
第四关明代语境：文本不绑定任何具体外貌与服饰，通用适配所有皮肤形象；性格活泼机灵、略带傲娇，融入大明‘极致精密、暗藏机关、大匠集大成’的榫卯巅峰与主线终局期待。
抽取与播放归 Y5 波（洗牌袋整轮不重复；池空/缺文件不弹+告警）。
英文字段（2026-11-01 增补）：可选「lines_en」（与 lines 逐条等长、按句一一对应）；lines_en 缺失或缺省时回退显示中文 lines，既有中文字段一律不动。
lines: 大明的榫卯，看似表面平平无奇，里头可藏着千百道暗扣呢，可别被它的外表给骗了！
‘锐眼’在这个时候最好使了！里头看不见的暗榫交错，全凭它给你照出一条明路来。
心浮气躁可磨不出大明的物件！深吸一口气，把心沉下去，手上的准头才出得来。
瞧瞧这线脚，再瞧瞧这交圈！严丝合缝得连张薄纸都塞不进去，这才叫绝活！
衣橱就在旁边呢，若是觉得手风不顺，不如换身新装扮转转运？
天赋值攒得可还称心？这一趟大明走完，保准让你收获满满！
别光顾着盯一处瞧，多转一转！大明的工匠最擅长‘面面俱到’，哪个角都得交代得明明白白。
哎呀……刚才在穿梭路上漏听的那句叮嘱，到底是什么来着？唔……算了不想了，脑壳疼！
加把劲！只要顺顺当当拿下这一关，你当年的通天本事可就彻底大功告成啦！
不管是紫禁城的大殿，还是文人案头的花梨木圈椅，底子全在一榫一卯的寸劲里。
累了就歇会儿，我不催你。当年这般复杂的暗榫，巧匠们琢磨好几个月也是常有的事。
啧啧，刚才下刀这一下，真有点‘神工意匠’的大家风范了！我果然没找错人！
阴阳相济，暗扣横生。把该嵌的格块嵌进去，它自然会给你回一声脆响！
别慌，榫口既然造出来了，就必定有它咬合的解法。静下心，慢慢试！
一根钉子不用，却能立起天下至巧的大器，这份手艺，无论走过多远岁月都是奇迹！
我就在旁边给你把关呢，放手去拼吧，胜利可就在眼前咯！
lines_en: Ming joinery looks plain as plain on the surface, but inside hide a hundred hidden clasps—don't let its face fool you!
This is where the Keen Eye works best! The unseen crossing of hidden tenons—it alone will light you a bright way through.
A restless heart never produces a Ming piece! Take a deep breath, let the mind sink down—only then will the hands find their true aim.
Look at this molding, then at this meeting of lines! Seam-tight enough to turn away a sheet of thin paper—now that is mastery!
The Wardrobe is just there—if your luck feels stuck, why not a new outfit to turn it around?
Is the Talent adding up nicely? Finish this Ming leg, and your haul is sure to be full!
Don't fixate on one spot—turn it about more! Ming craftsmen excelled at “covering every face”: every corner accounted for, clear and complete.
Oh... that instruction I failed to catch on the road between times—what was it again? Mm... forget it, my head aches!
Push on! Take this level cleanly, and your old heaven-reaching craft will be complete at last!
From the halls of the Forbidden City to the rosewood round-backed chair on a scholar's desk, the foundation lies in the inch-wise bite of tenon and mortise.
Rest a while if you're tired; I won't rush you. Back then, hidden tenons this intricate often kept clever craftsmen pondering for months.
Tsk tsk—that cut just now had the true air of a “divine craftsman”! I picked the right person after all!
Yin and yang in balance, hidden clasps in profusion. Set the right block into its place, and it will answer you with a crisp ring!
Don't panic—if the joint was made, a way to close it surely exists. Settle your heart, and try slowly!
Not one nail, yet raising the most ingenious vessels under heaven—however far the years have carried it, this craft is a miracle!
I'm right here checking your work—go all in! Victory is just before your eyes!
